description:
Create a DooDates scheduling poll so a group can vote on dates or time slots.
Suited to finding a date that works for several people (dinner, meeting,
rehearsal, match, family event). Dates are concrete ISO dates (a range such as
"a Saturday in October" must be expanded to dates). Dates and times are local
wall-clock times. No account needed.
The response contains vote_url (to share with participants) and admin_url
(needed later to see results or close the poll: it is the only access without an
account). The response also contains a ready-to-send share_message.

dates.description: Candidate dates, YYYY-MM-DD, 1 to 31, not in the past, within 18 months.

language.description: Language of the poll and of the messages (default: en).

time_slots.description: Time slots HH:MM-HH:MM applied to every date (6 max). Omit for all-day options.

times_by_date.description: Per-date time slots {"YYYY-MM-DD": ["HH:MM-HH:MM"]}; takes precedence over time_slots.

name: create_date_poll

admin_url.description: Organizer-only link: results and closing. Must be kept.

confirm_url.description: Link for the organizer to review and publish (draft polls).

title: Create a date poll
